conventions: Stable type:slug IDs; node and edge provenance required; source-scoped assertions; open-world facts; closed vocabulary.

Person.description: A human involved in the project.

Organization.description: A company, team, firm, or institution.

Component.description: A module, service, subsystem, or named part of the system.

File.description: A significant file, distinct from the thing it describes.

Technology.description: An external tool, library, platform, or system.

Concept.description: A named domain concept or recurring idea.

Decision.description: A recorded decision with attachable rationale, actors, and dates.

Event.description: A meeting, milestone, release, or dated occurrence.

Requirement.description: A stated requirement, constraint, or goal.

part_of.description: Subject is part or member of object.

authored_by.description: Subject was created or written by object.

involves.description: Subject event or decision involves object.

decided_in.description: Subject decision was made in object.

defined_in.description: Subject is defined in object file.

described_in.description: Subject is documented in object file.

relates_to.description: Generic symmetric association; use only as a last resort.
